settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Adjust language, rendering, and quality options.

shadow_map.label: Shadows
shadow_map.description: Casts real-time shadows from the sun and moon.

blob_shadow.label: Contact Shadow
blob_shadow.description: A soft shadow blob under placed objects so they look grounded.

rim_light.label: Rim Light
rim_light.description: A thin highlight along object edges to help them stand out.

god_rays.label: God Rays
god_rays.description: Sunlight shafts shining through gaps in terrain and objects.

ao.label: AO
ao.description: Soft shading in corners and where objects touch, for a bit more depth.

bloom.label: Bloom
bloom.description: Glow on very bright pixels (sun/moon, the night location beacon).

tilt_shift.label: Tilt-Shift
tilt_shift.description: Blurs the top/bottom of the screen for a miniature-diorama lens look.

chromatic_aberration.label: Chromatic Aberration
chromatic_aberration.description: Subtle color fringing toward the edges of the screen.

texture_pack.label: Texture
texture_pack.description: Uses detailed ground/object textures instead of flat colors.

high_dpr.label: High Resolution
high_dpr.description: Renders the canvas at up to 2x resolution (supersampling).

objects.label: Debug Gizmos
objects.description: Shows coordinate-system markers (map center, tile boundaries, etc.) for debugging.

structures.label: Buildings
structures.description: Whether buildings are rendered on the terrain.

ground_snap.label: Ground Snap
ground_snap.description: Keeps the camera's focus point snapped to the ground while panning.

dummy_toast.label: Dummy Toasts
dummy_toast.description: Shows sample notification toasts for testing.

license.geocoding_notice: To show place names, the map's center coordinates are rounded to about 11 m and sent to OpenStreetMap's Nominatim service. No location history is kept.

orientation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support the orientation sensor.
orientation.permission_error: An error occurred while requesting orientation sensor permission.

geolocation.unsupported: This environment doesn't support location services.
